description: Returns a one-time link that opens the developer's locally running app (using this application's development instance keys) signed in as user_id. Pick the user with list_users or create_user. Use it to check your work as a signed-in user; for the Clerk Dashboard, use create_browser_session. Open the returned url in the browser you control. It works once, even if opening it fails, and expires after an hour; call this tool again for a new one. Development instances only. The link is a credential: do not print, log, or save it.

organization_id.description: Organization (org_…) the session starts in. The user must be a member. Omit to use the user's last active one.

redirect_url.description: Page of the app running on this machine to land on after sign-in, as a full URL such as http://localhost:3000/dashboard.

sign_in_url.description: The app's own sign-in page on this machine, such as http://localhost:3000/sign-in. Pass it only if your browser can't follow Clerk's redirect to the app; then sign out any current user and open app_sign_in_url instead of url.

task_description.description: Short description of what you are testing.

user_id.description: ID of the user to sign in as (user_…), in the development instance.

name: create_test_session

agent_task_id.description: ID of the agent task behind this link (agttsk_…).

app_sign_in_url.description: Present when sign_in_url was given: the same one-time ticket on the app's own sign-in page. Open this or url, not both. It is a credential too.

redirect_url.description: Where the browser lands after Clerk signs the user in.

url.description: One-time sign-in link. Open it in the browser you control. It is a credential: do not print, log, or save it.

title: Create test session
